title: Ignore inline comments when parsing nameservers

timeline.message:
Ignore inline comments when parsing nameservers

Motivation:

The resolv.conf file may contain inline comments which should be ignored

Modifications:

- Detect if we have a comment after the ipaddress and if so skip it
- Add unit test

Result:

Fixes https://github.com/netty/netty/issues/9889
timeline.author: Norman Maurer
